projectName: Sector 04 Arterial Road Resurfacing & Pothole Rehabilitation
location: Begum Rokeya Sarani Link Road, Ward 14, Sector 04, Dhaka
problemDescription: A 1.8 km high-traffic arterial link road has been resurfaced three separate times within 15 months. Within weeks of each repair, recurring potholes, edge crumbling, and water-logged sub-base subsidence reappeared near the main intersection, slowing emergency and commuter traffic.
authority: Dhaka Metro North Roads & Highways Cell (Simulated Authority)

repairHistory.summary: Repair #1: Surface Asphalt Patching & Thin Bitumen Overlay
repairHistory.outcome: Failed within 4 months — top layer stripped during pre-monsoon showers.
repairHistory.contractorNote: Executed without deep aggregate base reconstruction.

repairHistory.summary: Repair #2: Emergency Monsoon Pothole Filling & WBM Stabilization
repairHistory.outcome: Partially washed out — standing stormwater softened compacted fill within 6 weeks.
repairHistory.contractorNote: Emergency tender issued; no roadside catch-pit drainage installed.

repairHistory.summary: Repair #3: Full-Width Carpet Re-carpeting & Wearing Course
repairHistory.outcome: Unresolved — longitudinal ruts and 18+ deep potholes documented again by May 2025.
repairHistory.contractorNote: 96.9% of total corridor allocation exhausted across three cycles.

timeline.title: Project Allocation & Work Order Issued
timeline.detail: ৳ 4.80 Cr (৳ 4,80,00,000) sanctioned for arterial link rehabilitation with 10-month target.

timeline.title: Repair Cycle #1 Completed
timeline.detail: Surface overlay completed (৳ 1.45 Cr billed); signs of edge raveling observed by May 2024.

timeline.title: Repair Cycle #2 Emergency Patching
timeline.detail: Water-bound macadam patch work billed at ৳ 1.30 Cr during monsoon traffic disruption.

timeline.title: Repair Cycle #3 Major Re-carpeting
timeline.detail: Third resurfacing bill of ৳ 1.90 Cr approved after November 2024 completion target lapsed.

timeline.title: Field Telemetry Flagged Recurring Surface Failure
timeline.detail: Civic inspection logged recurring surface fractures and blocked side drains at main intersection.

projectName: Sector 04 West Storm Drainage & Box Culvert Expansion
location: Canal Crossing & Storm Conduit, West Sector 04, Dhaka
problemDescription: Reinforced concrete box culvert and stormwater pump chamber expansion intended to relieve chronic ankle-to-knee monsoon waterlogging. Construction remains roughly 6 months past its January 31, 2025 contractual deadline with open trench barricades and incomplete outfall joints.
authority: Dhaka Urban Drainage & Canal Works Division (Simulated Authority)

repairHistory.summary: Pre-Project Emergency Desilting & Temporary Retaining Bund
repairHistory.outcome: Temporary relief only; silt refilled western outfall within two rainy seasons.
repairHistory.contractorNote: Led to sanctioning of permanent box culvert expansion package.

repairHistory.summary: Culvert Chamber Excavation, Dewatering & Precast Slab Placement
repairHistory.outcome: Stalled at 40% physical progress while 88.0% of project funds are recorded spent.
repairHistory.contractorNote: Cited utility line relocation delays and monsoon pump stoppage.

timeline.title: Drainage Expansion Tender Awarded
timeline.detail: ৳ 6.50 Cr (৳ 6,50,00,000) approved with an 11-month schedule ending January 31, 2025.

timeline.title: Phase-1 Trench Excavation & Mobilization Bill
timeline.detail: Mobilization and earthwork tranche disbursed; underground fiber-duct clash halted north wall.

timeline.title: Supplementary Dewatering & Variation Order
timeline.detail: Reported expenditure climbed to ৳ 5.72 Cr (88.0% of budget) while precast spans remained half-laid.

timeline.title: Contractual Completion Deadline Missed
timeline.detail: Target handover date passed with northern outlet and pump bay uncommissioned.

timeline.title: Mid-Monsoon Audit Snapshot
timeline.detail: 40% physical work verified against 88.0% financial disbursement; 6 months behind schedule.

projectName: Sector 04 Smart LED Streetlight & Underground Grid Corridor
location: Civic Boulevard & School Zone Perimeter, East Sector 04, Dhaka
problemDescription: Replaced 48 aging overhead sodium lamps and exposed feeder cables along the Civic Boulevard school corridor with surge-protected underground cabling, smart dusk-to-dawn dimming LED luminaires, and numbered maintenance poles.
authority: Dhaka Municipal Street Illumination Unit (Simulated Authority)

repairHistory.summary: Legacy Corridor Assessment: Faulty Sodium Ballast Replacement
repairHistory.outcome: Short-term maintenance highlighted chronic overhead cable corrosion.
repairHistory.contractorNote: Maintenance log justified modern underground armored duct conversion.

repairHistory.summary: Underground HDPE Conduit Laying & 48 Smart LED Pole Installations
repairHistory.outcome: All 48 poles pressure-tested and connected with smart timer telemetry.
repairHistory.contractorNote: Zero variation claims above sanctioned BOQ unit rates.

repairHistory.summary: Final Feeder Balancing & School Crosswalk Luminance Audit
repairHistory.outcome: Resolved — 100% uptime verified and completed ৳ 8,50,000 under budget.
repairHistory.contractorNote: Unspent contingency balance returned to municipal reserve.

timeline.title: Smart Illumination Tender Approved
timeline.detail: ৳ 1.80 Cr (৳ 1,80,00,000) allocated with target completion set for December 20, 2024.

timeline.title: Underground Armored Trenching Completed
timeline.detail: HDPE feeder ducts installed along 1.4 km Civic Boulevard without traffic closure.

timeline.title: 48 LED Luminaires Energized & Photometric Check
timeline.detail: 100% pole coverage verified across school gates and pedestrian crossings.

timeline.title: Project Commissioned 2 Days Ahead of Deadline
timeline.detail: Final audited spend settled at ৳ 1,71,50,000 (4.7% under allocated ceiling).
